notes: RULING NEEDED (rule 11): the report carries two sayings; «وحدثتني ابنتي أمينة أنه دفن لصلبي» is a second saying with its own transmitter (Amina), left out of the routes.
«خالد هو ابن الحارث» is an editor's gloss, left out.
The closing «حدثنا ابن أبي مريم ... سمع أنسا» is a second isnad after the matn for the same report: its own group.
